mapper.select: SELECT FROM refund_request WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT FROM refund_request WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND order_item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY (status <> 'FAILED') DESC, created_at DESC, refund_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_request (, next_check_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{refundId},#{userId},#{requestId},#{orderId},#{orderItemId},#{payOrderId},#{payScene}, #{channelRequestNo},#{amount},'PROCESSING',0, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_request SET version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE refund_id=#{refundId} AND version=#{version} AND next_check_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN')

UPDATE refund_request SET status=#{status}, last_error=#{error}, version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), next_check_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='UNKNOWN' THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END WHERE refund_id=#{refundId} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('PROCESSING','UNKNOWN')
